command: reasonix --permission-mode auto (interactive TUI, driven under a pty), prompted to read a file directly AND delegate with its `task` tool
note: Pins that `task` still dispatches a subagent at v1.25.2 — SUBAGENT_TOOLS was verified against v1.2.0 and nothing re-checked it. The prompt deliberately mixes an UNGATED read with the delegation: wire_to_pixels wants this slot to reach both Active and Delegating, and a run where every tool gates only ever reaches Waiting and Delegating. A first attempt naming `explore` got `run_skill`, which is deliberately excluded from SUBAGENT_TOOLS and mints no Task. Redacted: the owner column of a captured `ls -la`. The bytes are otherwise verbatim.
